questions.question: Does the company disclose a climate strategy aligned with recognized frameworks?
Has the company published a Net Zero or emissions reduction target?
Has the company conducted a biodiversity impact/dependency assessment?
Does the company disclose physical climate risks (flood, heat, cyclone, etc.)?
Does the company disclose climate adaptation measures?
questions.expected_evidence: Flood resilient design, relocation, adaptation plan

questions.question: Does the company publish worker health & safety metrics?
Does the company disclose community engagement initiatives?
Does the company publish employee diversity or inclusion metrics?
Does the board provide oversight of ESG matters?
Are ESG risks integrated into enterprise risk management?
Are executive incentives linked to ESG performance?
